equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet; charged once here, flows are consolidated

equity_bridge.item: CCBA acquisition (75%, US$2.6bn) held value-neutral at cost
equity_bridge.note: Pending completion (targeted H2 2026). Cash-out of ~EUR1.37bn + 21.1m new shares + assumed CCBA debt against 75% of CCBA's flows, assumed to net to zero at the purchase price. See inputs.notes for the magnitude of the un-modelled swing.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Medium-term organic revenue target of 6-7%/yr (FY2025 AR, reaffirmed H1 FY2026) less ~1.5pp average EUR translation drag from EM currencies (FY2023 organic 16.9% vs reported 10.7%; FY2024 13.8% vs 5.6%; FY2025 8.1% vs 7.9%), cross-checked against the equity 5yr CAGR of 7.9% and revenue 3yr CAGR of 8.1%. Used as the FY2027-FY2029 base path (5.0-5.5%) before decelerating.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 7.9% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 13.6% and EPS 5yr CAGR 17.8%. Both the revenue and EPS 5yr figures are inflated by the FY2020 COVID trough base and the 2022 Egypt (Coca-Cola Bottling Company of Egypt) acquisition; the EPS 3yr CAGR of 31.9% is inflated by FY2022's Russia-related impairments depressing the base (EPS 1.13 vs 1.49 in FY2021). The equity CAGR is held down by EM currency translation losses through OCI (-213m in FY2024 alone) and a 44% dividend payout. None of the three is a clean forward proxy; the selected 5.0% is anchored to guidance.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (CSV free_cash_flow - SBC; interest income is in investing so no adjustment; lease principal not available before FY2024 so the historical series excludes it, unlike the forward flows). Owner FCF 3yr CAGR 2.1% vs reported 2.3%: SBC (16.5 -> 22.1) is growing faster than FCF but is only 0.19% of revenue, so the gap is immaterial. The real story is that owner FCF has grown far slower than revenue (2.1% vs 8.1% over 3 years) because capex stepped up from 5.7% of revenue (FY2022/FY2024) to 6.4% (FY2025) and working-capital inflows shrank; the forward build therefore takes FCF margin from ~5.8% (FY2025 owner FCF / revenue) toward ~7.9% only as capex intensity normalises toward 5% over ten years.

scenario_narratives.base: CCH delivers its medium-term algorithm on a standalone basis: organic revenue at the top of 6-7% in FY2026 (upgraded in August after a volume-led H1 +9.6%), then 5.0-5.5% in EUR as roughly 1.5pp/yr of EM pricing is given back in translation; EBITDA margin expands ~25bps/yr from 15.2% to 17.0% as Emerging (13.5% EBIT margin, 47% of revenue) scales; capex intensity glides from 6.4% to 5.0% as the 2024-25 capacity build in Egypt and Nigeria is absorbed. Owner FCF margin rises from ~5.8% to ~7.9% by FY2035. The CCBA acquisition is held at cost (value-neutral) pending completion.
scenario_narratives.bull: Africa-led compounding: Energy (10th straight year of double-digit growth) and Sparkling per-capita catch-up in Nigeria and Egypt keep organic growth at 6-7% for five years with benign FX, margin expansion runs at the top of the 20-40bps/yr target to 18%, and capex normalises faster. CCBA (not in the flows) would add to this case if integration lands the guided low-single-digit EPS accretion and the 25% option is exercised at a fair price.
scenario_narratives.bear: The EM axis turns: a Nigeria/Egypt devaluation cycle, Russia/Ukraine escalation or sanctions, and EU sugar-tax/DRS pressure cut EUR revenue growth to 2-3% from FY2027, margins compress 70bps on transaction FX and input costs, and CCBA integration absorbs management while leverage sits at 1.5-2.0x. Capex stays elevated at 6% to defend share.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on a standalone CCH, EUR flows at a EUR WACC, converted to the GBp quote at 84.61. Leases charged once as an operating cost (treatment B), NCI deducted once at book, SBC expensed and the share count held flat, risk charged once in an 8.5% WACC with scenarios varying only operating drivers. The CCBA acquisition is treated as value-neutral at cost until it completes and its first consolidated accounts are filed. Terminal value is the lower of Gordon at 2.5% and 20x year-10 owner FCF; the entry price demands a 15% IRR with the terminal value rebuilt at the hurdle.
key_risks_to_valuation: EM currency translation and transaction exposure (Naira, Egyptian pound, rouble, hryvnia; rand and Kenyan shilling post-CCBA) -- the gap between 6-7% organic and EUR reported growth is the single largest driver swing

CCBA integration and leverage: the deal is held at cost here; a 25% value gain or loss on the EUR2.2bn purchase price is ~EUR1.5/share either way, and completion failure would leave EUR2.1bn of surplus bonds to redeem
Capex intensity: the base assumes a glide from 6.4% to 5.0% of revenue over ten years; if the company holds its 6.5-7.5% (incl. leases) target indefinitely, terminal FCF is ~1.4pp of revenue lower
Terminal-value weight: ~60% of EV sits in the terminal value at 8.5%/2.5%; each 50bps of WACC moves the base value ~8-9%
Franchisor dependency: concentrate pricing and brand strategy are set by TCCC under the incidence-based model

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for CCH.L at inputs.price_as_of (GBp); 52-week range 3,350-5,195p. FX from Yahoo EURGBP=X, EURUSD=X, GBPUSD=X and the CCHGY ADR for parity, all 2026-10-09.
data_sources.financials: research/CCH.L/Reports/CCH.L_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, FY2018-H1 FY2026) and kpis table; FY2025 Integrated Annual Report (cash flow statement, notes 11, 14, 16, 23, 25; APM reconciliations); H1 FY2026 half-yearly report (balance sheet, notes 7, 10, 14, 15); Q1 2026 trading update; H1 2026 results presentation.
data_sources.qualitative: research/CCH.L/Reports/CCH.L_Analysis.json (2026-10-10): segment mix, CCBA deal terms and clearance status, FY2026 and medium-term guidance, bull/bear axes.

sanity_check_note.issue: scripts/sanity_check.py applied inputs.fx_rate (84.61 GBp per EUR, reporting->quote, dcf_engine.py convention) in the wrong direction: historical_table() MULTIPLIED the GBp FY-end price series by 84.61 instead of dividing (FY2025 printed 'price' 325,071 = 3,842p x 84.61), inflating historical P/B, EV/EBITDA and P/Sales by ~fx^2 (P/B 18,660-30,718x printed); and implied_multiples() compared the GBp intrinsic value (3,685.56) against EUR book value and EBITDA with no conversion at all (P/B 348x, EV/EBITDA 771x printed). The script's passed:true is therefore built on nonsense inputs and has been overridden to false. Same defect as AAF.L/ABF.L/ADM.L (memory: sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-systemic-bug, sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-conflict). No DCF driver was changed.
sanity_check_note.method: Hand-bridged on a single consistent currency (EUR): FY-end GBp price = printed / 84.61; EUR price = GBp / 84.61 (the script's own single-rate convention, so year-specific EURGBP of 0.83-0.90 over FY2018-FY2025 is approximated by today's 0.8461, worth up to ~6% on any one year's multiple). SBC-adjusted on both sides like the script: P/E on (net income - SBC), EV/EBITDA on (EBITDA - SBC), EV = market cap + (total_debt - cash) from the Metrics.csv.
sanity_check_note.verdict: GENUINE PASS. Every implied multiple at the base and weighted IV sits inside the FY2018-FY2025 range on FY2025 denominators (net debt at the 3 Jul 2026 balance sheet); no peak-earnings extrapolation, WACC, growth or exit-multiple fix is warranted. The current price is at the upper end of the historical range (EV/EBITDA 11.4x vs 8.3-12.4x; P/B 4.8x vs max 4.3x), which is consistent with the model's -14% base-case upside rather than a defect in it.

inputs.share_count_basis: 363.9m shares outstanding (issued less treasury) at 3 July 2026 per the H1 FY2026 interim, plus 0.1m dilutive stock options (FY2025 AR note 11: 363.3m diluted vs 363.2m basic). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows. The ~21.1m new shares (5.47% of enlarged capital, ~385.0m post) to be issued to Gutsche Family Investments on CCBA completion are deliberately NOT in this count: the model is standalone CCH with the acquisition held value-neutral at cost (see equity_bridge), so neither the new shares, the EUR1.37bn cash consideration, CCBA's assumed debt nor CCBA's flows are included. Pro-forma the count is ~385m.
inputs.net_debt_note: 3 July 2026 balance sheet (H1 FY2026 interim note 10). total_debt = current borrowings 1,662.5 + non-current borrowings 4,506.3 = 6,168.8 (bonds and bank debt, EXCLUDING lease liabilities of 288.7 under lease treatment B). cash = cash and cash equivalents 3,873.8 + time deposits in other financial assets 864.5 = 4,738.3. Company APM net debt is 1,413.6 after a 16.9 fixed-to-floating swap fair-value credit, which this model leaves out (conservative by 16.9). The cash pile includes the EUR2.1bn of April 2026 bonds pre-funding the CCBA consideration; standalone net debt is therefore the right standalone anchor and the acquisition cash-out is netted against the acquired business in the bridge at zero.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: Company APM free cash flow definition, FY2025: net cash from operating activities 1,513.5 - payments for PP&E 752.6 + proceeds from PP&E sales 6.1 - principal repayments of lease obligations 69.6 = 697.4 (company reported 700.0 after excluding acquisition costs under its 2025 amended definition). The Metrics.csv free_cash_flow of 760.9 is OCF - capex before lease principal and disposal proceeds. Interest received (130.6 finance income) sits in INVESTING in CCH's cash flow statement, so neither figure contains interest income.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 consolidated cash flow statement, 'Employee performance shares' add-back EUR22.1m (FY2024: 15.6). EquityAwardTaxes 0 in every year (no net-share-settlement tax line in the financing section). The SBC note's 23.8 expense figure includes deferred MIP shares; the cash-flow add-back is used for consistency with the historical series.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 finance income was 130.6 on a EUR2.5bn cash pile, but it is NOT deducted: (i) CCH is a net-debt company (1.4bn), so the net-cash > 1x FCF trigger does not apply; (ii) interest received is classified in investing activities, so it is already outside both reported_fcf and the EBITDA-based component build. Deducting it would strip income that was never in the flows.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in FY2025 or H1 FY2026 (FY2024: 183.0; FY2023: 42.6). The flat count is a modelling convention CCH has not been funding since 2024; SBC at 0.19% of revenue is small enough that the unfunded dilution is ~0.1%/yr.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in EUR (consolidated statements state 'EUR million'); LSE quote in GBp (pence, 1/100 GBP). fx_rate 84.61 GBp per EUR = Yahoo EURGBP=X 0.8461 x 100 at 2026-10-09T22:18Z; cross-check EURUSD 1.1206 / GBPUSD 1.3233 = 0.8468 (0.1% apart). Parity check against the 1:1 CCHGY ADR: 4,282p = GBP42.82 x 1.3233 = USD56.66 vs CCHGY last USD56.85 (2026-10-09 19:50Z), a 0.3% tie confirming direction and quote basis. EUR per-share values are multiplied by 84.61 to reach the GBp quote basis; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in GBp, comparable to current_price.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T15:35:18Z (LSE regular-session close, 16:35 BST; not an after-hours print; within 52-week range 3,350-5,195p)
inputs.wacc_rationale: EUR-denominated flows discounted at a EUR-built WACC of 8.5%: 10y Bund ~2.7% risk-free, 5.5% mature-market ERP, equity beta ~0.85 for a franchise bottler, plus a ~1.5pp country-risk premium for ~47% of revenue from Emerging markets (Nigeria, Egypt, Russia, Ukraine) -> cost of equity ~8.9%; pre-tax cost of debt ~3.8% (April 2026 bonds priced 3.375-4.0%), ~2.8% after tax; market-value weights ~92/8 (market cap ~EUR18.4bn vs net debt 1.4bn) -> ~8.4%, rounded to 8.5%. The EM/FX/geopolitical risk is charged ONCE, here in the discount rate; the three scenarios vary operating drivers (growth, margin, capex, WC) and use the same 8.5%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. The full IFRS-16 lease cash charge is deducted inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path = (principal repayments 69.6 + interest expense on leases 20.0) / revenue 11,604.5 = 0.77% (FY2025 AR cash flow statement and note 16); lease liabilities (288.7 at 3 Jul 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt; and da_pct is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation: 424.2 total depreciation - 70.9 ROU depreciation + 1.5 amortisation = 354.8 = 3.06% of revenue, so the lease is not charged twice through EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows; NCI book value EUR96.8m (3 Jul 2026) deducted once in the equity_bridge. NCI share of profit is ~nil (FY2025: -0.4; H1 FY2026: -0.2), so attributable and consolidated flows coincide and no leakage driver is needed.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US', with owner-fcf-adaptations for dual currency, leases, NCI). CCH is a franchise bottler with real capex (6.4% of revenue) and EUR0.7bn of free cash flow; not a bank/REIT/LIC, no memory entry, first valuation. CCBA: the agreed acquisition of 75% of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (US$2.6bn: US$1.3bn cash to TCCC for 41.52%, US$308m cash + 5.47% of enlarged CCH capital to GFI for 33.48%; implied 100% equity US$3.4bn; option over TCCC's remaining 25%) had EGM approval (19 Jan 2026) and 4 of 6 antitrust clearances at 5 Aug 2026, with completion targeted H2 2026. It is NOT consolidated here: the model values standalone CCH on the 3 July 2026 balance sheet and holds the acquisition value-neutral at cost (equity_bridge item at 0), i.e. assumes CCH pays fair value. The un-modelled swing is small: a 25% value gain or loss on the ~EUR2.2bn (75%) purchase price is ~EUR1.5/share (~3-4% of value). Pro-forma, revenue rises ~30%, shares ~385m, net debt/EBITDA to 1.5-2.0x, and 25% of CCBA becomes NCI. REVISIT on completion with CCBA's first consolidated accounts. Associates: share of integral equity-method results (15.4, non-cash) sits inside adjusted EBITDA while the 11.7 of cash receipts sits in investing; the two roughly offset and no bridge item is made. Interest paid on debt is in financing and never in the flows (unlevered build). Impairments (6.5) excluded from D&A. Working capital is structurally negative (payables 3.3bn+ vs receivables+inventory 2.2bn), so revenue growth RELEASES cash: FY2025 +83.4 on +850 revenue (9.8%), FY2024 +100.8 on +570 (17.7%); base captures 8%.

bear.narrative: FY2026 lands at the bottom of guidance (H1 is banked). From FY2027 a Nigeria/Egypt-style devaluation cycle, Russia exit or sanctions shock, and sugar-tax/DRS rollouts cut EUR revenue growth to 2-3% while transaction-FX cost inflation and CCBA integration distraction compress EBITDA margin 70bps to 14.5%. Capex stays at 6% of revenue to defend share and capacity with no deceleration dividend; working-capital release shrinks with growth.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 7.5% reported EUR = organic at the top end of the raised 6-7% range (H1 +9.6% organic incl. ~3pp from four extra selling days that reverse in H2) plus ~0.5pp FX (H1 reported-organic gap +1.2pp, guidance moved to a EUR0-10m EBIT tailwind). FY2027-FY2029 5.0-5.5% = 6-7% organic less ~1.5pp average EM translation drag. Decelerates to 3.0% by FY2034 as EM per-capita catch-up matures; terminal 2.5% EUR nominal.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 adjusted EBITDA margin 15.17% (1,759.9 / 11,604.5; H1 FY2026 15.9% vs 15.3% a year earlier, +60bps). FY2026 15.6% = organic EBIT +8-10% guided on +7% revenue (~+35bps). Then ~+25bps/yr for eight years, the midpoint of the 20-40bps/yr medium-term comparable EBIT margin target, flattening at 17.0% from FY2034. The margin is post-IFRS-16; the lease cash charge is deducted separately.
base.capex_rationale: Company target 6.5-7.5% of NSR INCLUDES lease principal (~0.6%); FY2025 was 7.1% on that basis = 6.4% ex-lease (752.6 - 6.1 proceeds). Base holds 6.4% in FY2026 (H1 FY2026 ran 6.1% total on phasing, full year guided within range) and glides to 5.0% by FY2035 as growth decelerates from 7.5% to 3%. Terminal net investment (capex 5.0 - D&A 3.4 = 1.6% of revenue) supports 2.5-3% growth at ~0.5x invested capital/revenue (ROIC 19.4%).
base.tax_rationale: Comparable ETR guided 26-28% (H1 FY2026 actual 27.1%); FY2025 book ETR 28.0%, cash taxes paid 308.7 = 23.6% of EBIT (1,306). 27% on EBIT (unlevered; interest shield is in WACC) is slightly conservative against cash. Pillar Two 15% minimum has no material effect per the FY2025 AR.
base.wc_rationale: Negative working capital bottler: FY2025 inflow 83.4 on +850 revenue (9.8% capture), FY2024 100.8 on +570 (17.7%). Base 8% of the revenue CHANGE, below both years.

bull.narrative: Organic growth holds at the top of the 6-7% range through FY2029 with EM currencies broadly stable (FX drag ~0.5pp instead of 1.5pp), Energy and Sparkling keep compounding double-digit in Africa, and margin expansion runs at the top of the 20-40bps target to 18% EBITDA. Capex intensity normalises faster as the 2024-25 capacity wave is absorbed. Same WACC: risk is charged once, in the discount rate.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: 47% of revenue is Emerging-market (Nigeria, Egypt, Russia, Ukraine) with currency and sanctions risk the company itself ranks as its top principal risk, and a transformational acquisition at ~US$3.4bn equity value is closing into higher leverage and more frontier-FX exposure. Bull trimmed from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to hold for a decade (top-of-range organic growth, benign FX, top-of-range margin expansion, faster capex normalisation). Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
trip_reasons: fx_direction_bug: sanity_check.py multiplied the GBp price series by inputs.fx_rate 84.61 instead of dividing (historical P/B 18,660-30,718x printed) and implied_multiples() compared the GBp intrinsic value against EUR book/EBITDA with no conversion (P/B 348x printed). The script's passed:true was built on nonsense inputs and is overridden to false per memory sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-systemic-bug. See top-level sanity_check_note for the hand-bridged EUR multiples, which pass genuinely (base IV P/E 17.3x, P/B 4.12x, EV/EBITDA 9.95x vs FY2018-25 range 14.6-25.2x / 2.61-4.29x / 8.31-12.37x). No driver was changed.
diagnosis: Dual-currency ticker (EUR statements, GBp quote). Multiples recomputed by hand in EUR; see sanity_check_note.
